- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed specific guidelines for several popular festivals, including:

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] The New York International Fringe Festival (FringeNYC): Submission window October to December, full-length plays (at least 60 minutes), submission fee $40-$60.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed information about the submission process for FringeNYC, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Online application submission through the FringeNYC website, typically open from October to December.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Script submission in PDF format, production team information, and a non-refundable submission fee of $40 to $60.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notification of selection status in late spring.
